title.value: A Tale of Tails: Model Collapse as a Change of Scaling Laws
title.justification: The title appears clearly at both the beginning and end of the document.
title.quote: A Tale of Tails: Model Collapse as a Change of Scaling Laws

analysis.description: The paper investigates the impact of synthetic data on scaling laws for AI models, particularly focusing on whether models trained on such data will continue to improve or degenerate into model collapse. It develops a theoretical framework and validates it through experiments with transformers on arithmetic tasks and text generation using the Llama2 model.

type.justification: The paper is centered around developing a theoretical framework and analyzing various decay phenomena related to scaling laws.
type.quote: We develop a theoretical framework of model collapse through the lens of scaling laws.

name.justification: The primary field is Machine Learning as it explores scaling laws and model performance under synthetic data influence.
name.quote: we carefully zoom into the scaling behavior of LLM-style models.

name.quote: Our theory is validated by large-scale experiments with a transformer on an arithmetic task and text generation using the large language model Llama2.
